output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes in every location in October 2024. That matches the Made Here redesign, which the board approved knowing it would add 4 to 5 minutes and set a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction, repeat visits, sales and margin did not suffer. The 12-minute benchmark covers only chains built on pre-prepared or frozen food. A past trial of frozen components cut food quality. The Riverside slowdown tracks the saute/pasta cook's departure, an unfilled position and transfer requests deferred by group operations. Why the cook left is disputed, so removing the GM is unjustified. Ticket-time bonuses were gamed in the 2023 audit. Fill the Riverside vacancy and keep the scratch menu.
